verdict_rule: reproduced iff every E and U assertion passes (engine distinctly targets; UI renders identically = bug still observed)
key_observations: Engine (v0.102.0): both games put the Emperor exile trigger on the stack with targets == [{'Object': oid}] (exactly one target); game A targeted Ballista oid 28, game B targeted Ballista oid 7; both oids are Walking Ballista objects in P0's graveyard.
P0's viewer envelope and the authoritative export at the before-responding moment carry the same target Object id in both games (E4).
After resolution the chosen Ballista is in Exile, the stack is empty, and the game proceeds (E5).
UI (client 611d205): stack target label is '-> Walking Ballista' in both variants -- identical, name-only, no object id.
StackTargetArcs resolves both Ballista oids to the same graveyard-pile anchor (grouped pile element, identical rect); drawn arc landing endpoints identical (48.234375, 67.53125) across variants.
ZoneViewer renders both Ballistas identically (modulo data-object-id) with no target highlight on either card.

revalidation_of.note: Old run derived variant B by token-replacing one export; this run played TWO REAL games (A targets oid 28, B targets oid 7).
